title: Orchestrator dispatch profile
description: One agent's dispatch profile, a YAML file in the controller's profiles_dir: what the agent may use (tools, a path scope, MCP grants per lane), how its prompt is built and where it may run. It is a derived artifact of the compiled agent profile (platform/agent_profile): path_scope is that profile's memory scopes in the shared tree, grants its MCP grants as the MCP catalog render writes them; rendering the rest from it is a follow-up. The Go loader (orchestrator/internal/profile) is the authority and is stricter: it decodes unknown keys at every level as errors except the top-level extension keys its config lists in profile_extensions (which this schema therefore allows), checks every path_scope entry against the configured scope zones, resolves prompt_context against the config's prompt_dir, prompt_state_files and facts_commands, and renders grants against the catalog. Its tests hold this schema's keys to the Go types and its examples and negatives to the loader's verdicts.

id.description: The profile's own identifier (with its version), recorded per job.

agent_key.description: The key jobs are submitted under; never one the scope zones reserve.

path_scope.description: The prefixes the agent may write and read in the shared tree (relative, clean, no `..`, no hidden segment; no writable prefix in a denied root of the zones).

toolsets.description: Per lane, the toolsets a runner enables when the profile has no grants (opaque to the controller).

default_task_description.description: The task when a job is submitted without one.

prompt_context.description: Prompt blocks beyond the task text, each off unless turned on, each naming only what the controller's config lists.

state_file.description: An absolute path listed in prompt_state_files.

cursor_file.description: The agent's own cursor store, exactly the cursor_file_template for its agent_key.

facts.description: A name in the config's facts_commands.

local_only.description: Never fall back to a cloud backend.

grants.description: The MCP server instances the agent may use, per lane: both lanes or neither.

name.description: The server name the runner, and so the model, sees; unique in its lane.

kind.description: A kind of the controller's catalog (`hnx mcp catalog render --client orchestrator`).

env.description: Values of the kind's allowed_env keys only, each as the catalog classifies it (pinned, profile-bound or free in a shape: orchestrator/internal/grants). No `${...}` reference.

timeout.description: Seconds; 0 or absent: the kind's timeout.
